title: Rough Day? We made a game for that.
author: llamaGames12
selftext:
So we wanted to make something that feels joyful and has zero stress. You communicate with creatures via emojis, so there's also very little to read, you explore, collect Lumis that turn into creatures and play puzzle games as you travel deeper and deeper into the world.

Used **Hyper3d** on textures and 3D models plus **Opus 5.5** on game dev!

If you like it please drop a wishlist here <3 :

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4120640/A\_Burning\_Star/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4120640/A_Burning_Star/)
